answer: Because the falcon reference is updated at each lantern checkpoint, coverage is the scarce resource, and the vine audit records how much each answer added. Repeating an already-covered mechanism thus earns nothing extra, so one template cannot pay for 114 aliases however many keys the operator holds. Answers are compared against a hidden reference set of 8 accepted mechanisms and scored on how much new ground they cover rather than on how closely they match. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
